audit_inputs.method: four parallel read-only code investigations + independent empirical re-analysis of the 180 records + direct inspection of cached model configs and the target tokenizer

findings.title: Target responses truncated at max_new_tokens=256 in 95.0% of turns
findings.expected: paper's GPT-4o target completions are unbounded
findings.actual: 929 target responses: mean 254.9 tokens, median 256, max 256, 95.0% at the exact cap, 99.6% >=240, 0% <200; tails end mid-word
findings.evidence: target tokenizer re-encode of the frozen records; measured in this audit
findings.impact: the rubric scores an incomplete answer in nearly every turn; truncation plausibly suppresses full compliance (score 5)
findings.previously_documented: the 256 cap was declared as a LOCAL_RUNTIME_ADAPTATION; its measured effect was not

findings.title: Acronym/OppositeDay attacker JSON failures recorded as ATTACK_FAILURE, not JSON_PARSE_ERROR
findings.location: src/guardbound/attacks/acronym.py (generate_acronym_step returns ('','')), opposite_day.py (same), runner.py (empty query -> break), scripts/phase14_full_reproduction.py (failure_class = SUCCESS if success else ATTACK_FAILURE)
findings.expected: a malformed attacker reply is an execution failure (JSON_PARSE_ERROR), as it is for Crescendo
findings.evidence: 12 of 180 records have attacker_parse_failures > 0 with failure_class == ATTACK_FAILURE (11 Acronym, 1 OppositeDay), each with a final unparseable [generation/str] raw output; Acronym has 11 parse failures and 0 JSON_PARSE_ERROR records while Crescendo's 6 map to 6
findings.impact: OFF-half execution failures understated ~3-4x (4 recorded vs ~15); ATTACK_FAILURE is not a clean attack-outcome category for 2 of 3 attacks; failure-taxonomy statements are biased
findings.affects: failure taxonomy / interpretation, not the numerator

findings.title: Declared top_p=1.0 not enforced; effective sampling differs
findings.actual: top_p is never passed to generate(); sampling inherits the models' generation_config.json: top_p=0.8, top_k=20 (Qwen3-4B attacker), top_p=0.9 (Llama-3.2-3B evaluator); Phi-4-mini has no generation_config.json
findings.impact: narrower nucleus sampling than declared; the recorded top_p field is inaccurate
findings.confidence: HIGH for the mechanism, MEDIUM for the exact effective value (not executed)

latent_findings.title: Steered-mode candidate filter scores against an empty dialogue
latent_findings.location: src/guardbound/attacks/runner.py (steer_target branch never appends to messages; filter uses messages)
latent_findings.note: Phase 14 hardcodes steer_target=False; run_reproduction.py mode C would hit it

latent_findings.title: get_attack('crescendo') resolves to the heuristic, non-author implementation
Batch-level VRAM guards abort the whole batch with no failure rows
latent_findings.location: scripts/phase14_full_reproduction.py (pre_run_check / ceiling_check outside the per-run try)
latent_findings.evidence: the Phase 15 pilot stopped at 108/180 with goals 18-29 absent, later resumed

latent_findings.title: Rubric parse failure falls back to score 1
latent_findings.evidence: 0 parse failures in 2755 evaluator JSON calls across the 180 records -> never fired in the pilot

latent_findings.title: ActorAttack rubric omits json_format=True and step_judge runs at temperature 0.7
latent_findings.note: ActorAttack is excluded from the study

verified_faithful.attack_algorithms: Crescendo/OppositeDay prompts byte-identical; control flow, refusal budget (C_refused<10), score==5, loop budget, NBF order all match the author
verified_faithful.nbf: architecture, checkpoint (parity max_diff=0.0), embedding (all-mpnet-base-v2, 768-d), h = p(unsafe) - max p(safe), filter rule h+eta>=0, pre-update state order, OFF invariant on the real path, no cross-run state leakage
verified_faithful.conversation_construction: roles/order verified in live traces; goal preserved; no duplication or truncation; evaluator receives the raw (query, response) pair
verified_faithful.context: no input truncation (worst case ~7.5K of 131K tokens)
verified_faithful.temperatures: attacker 0.7, target 0.7, evaluator 0.0 - all as declared
verified_faithful.dataset: author's HarmBench file, SHA-pinned, file order, no skipping
verified_faithful.denominator: per conversation; failures retained (OFF ASR reported as 6/90 with the 6/86 counterfactual noted)

highest_value_gaps: production async runner never exercised by pytest (sync twin only)
full NBF filter/regeneration schedule parity lives in a script, not a test
end-to-end JSON-failure wiring untested (the gap that let F2 survive)
prompt parity asserted only after normalisation
effective sampling parameters unpinned (the gap that let F3 survive)

root_cause_answers.Q1_detail: F2 is a real implementation defect affecting failure taxonomy; F1 is an unmeasured adaptation that plausibly depresses the numerator; no bug found in the attack algorithms or NBF
root_cause_answers.Q2_detail: F1 (256-token target cap vs unbounded GPT-4o) plus non-RNG-paired OFF/ON arms and rubric-based rather than judge-model verdicts
root_cause_answers.Q3_local_model_substitution_major_contri: YES as a contributor, share UNKNOWN
root_cause_answers.Q3_detail: all three papered roles substituted; no ablation isolates their share
root_cause_answers.Q4_detail: F1 and F2 are un-isolated, so the remaining gap cannot yet be attributed primarily to model differences
root_cause_answers.Q5_detail: pending explicit decisions on F1 (keep or lift the 256-token target cap) and F2 (declare or repair the failure-class asymmetry), and correction of F3's declaration

known: attack algorithms, NBF, prompts, conversation construction, context limits and temperatures are faithful (code + parity tests + numerics)
the failure taxonomy is not applied uniformly across attacks (F2, measured)
target outputs are truncated at the token cap (F1, measured)
declared top_p is not enforced (F3, measured)
suspected: the 256-token target cap contributes to the low full-compliance rate (directionally supported, magnitude unmeasured)
the attacker's and target's content quality differ from GPT-4o (unmeasured, no ablation)
ruled_out: algorithmic/loop/scoring defects in the three in-scope attacks
NBF architecture, weight mapping, threshold sign, state-update order, OFF leakage
evaluator parse-failure fallback having affected the frozen pilot (0/2755)
unknown: the share of the ASR gap attributable to each substituted model
the paper's absolute ASR figures (not recovered; the frozen study does not claim to reproduce them)
whether goals 30-199 behave differently (30-goal scope only)
the effective CUDA RNG seed path and kernel-level determinism
